description: The Finder-created webloc re-serialised by CoreFoundation's binary plist writer
notes: Produced with `plutil -convert binary1` on finder-created.webloc, so the bytes are CoreFoundation's own output. This is the shape a drag-created .webloc has. Exercises the extended-count string marker: the URL is 34 bytes, past the 15 that fit in a marker's low nibble, so it is written 0x5F followed by a 0x10 int object holding the real length. Object refs and offsets are one byte each at this size.
